::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/analytics/measures"}
#docs
Read this instead of hard-coding a list of metrics: a measure that is not here does not exist, and new ones appear here before anything else announces them.

Each entry says what the number MEANS, whether it is a value at an instant (`kind: stock`) or a sum over a window (`kind: flow`), what unit it is in, which dimensions it may be split by, which grains it may be shown at, and whether a comparison window is meaningful. A client that renders its picker from this payload cannot offer a cut the engine would refuse.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The measure id. Pass it as `measure`. |
| `data.name` | `string` | The display name. |
| `data.description` | `string` | One sentence on what the number means. |
| `data.kind` | `string` | `stock` is a value at the end of a period. `flow` is a sum across a period. One of `stock`, `flow`. |
| `data.unit` | `string` | The unit of the value. One of `money`, `count`, `ratio`, `bps`. |
| `data.aggregate` | `string` | How periods combine. One of `sum`, `last`, `ratio`, `none`. |
| `data.dimensions` | `array of string` | The dimensions you can split by. |
| `data.grains` | `array of string` | The period sizes that the measure supports. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | `per_currency` if the value is money in each currency, `none` otherwise. One of `per_currency`, `none`. |
| `data.value_as_of` | `string` | Which instant the figure describes. `computed_at` means the live book, with no history. One of `period_end`, `computed_at`. |
| `data.supports_compare` | `boolean` | True if the measure accepts `compare`. |
| `data.segmentable` | `boolean` | True if the measure accepts `segment`. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The measure registry |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/analytics/measures" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "mrr",
      "name": "MRR",
      "kind": "stock",
      "unit": "money",
      "dimensions": [
        "plan"
      ],
      "grains": [
        "day"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
::
